KEY_ID.description: Logical key identifier used across publication and grant records.

SLOT_ID.description: Host-managed key slot or key handle identifier.

ROLE.description: Role the referenced key fulfills for the module flow.

ALGORITHM.description: Algorithm or key family for the referenced key.

PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional public bytes for verification or peer identity binding.

VERSION.description: Logical version of the referenced key.

EXPIRES_AT.description: Expiration time in unix milliseconds, or 0 if unbounded.

HOST_MANAGED.description: True when the secret material remains in the host key slot.

MESSAGE_TYPE.description: Distinguishes configuration inputs from runtime status outputs.

ROLE.description: Indicates whether the configuration/status applies to server/provider or requester/client behavior.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID advertised by the licensing provider.

PROVIDER_SIGNING_KEY.description: Host-managed long-lived signing key used for grant signatures.

PROVIDER_WRAPPING_KEY.description: Host-managed wrapping key used to protect per-publication content keys for requesters.

REQUESTER_SIGNING_KEY.description: Optional requester signing key reference for requester-hosted flows.

EXPIRES_AT.description: Runtime expiry in unix milliseconds, or 0 if unbounded.

MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS.description: Maximum accepted requester/provider clock skew in milliseconds.

CAPABILITY_TOKEN.description: Optional capability token bytes returned with successful grants.

INITIALIZED.description: Whether the runtime has been initialized successfully.

NEEDS_ROTATION.description: Whether the runtime needs issuer key rotation or refreshed configuration.

STATUS_CODE.description: Optional machine-readable status code for status/error responses.

STATUS_MESSAGE.description: Optional human-readable status or error message.
